telemetry_sources: Packet capture at the WKS-4471 and WKS-4472 network interfaces
environment._constraint: This scenario has NO host telemetry. There are no process, file, registry or authentication events available — only network flows. Endpoint agent coverage does not extend to these hosts.

alert.rule_name: Workstation-to-Workstation DCERPC Session on a Service-Control Endpoint
alert.description: A workstation opened an RPC endpoint-mapper session to a peer workstation and immediately followed it with a session to the dynamic port returned by that mapper, uploading a payload substantially larger than the response. Workstation-to-workstation RPC on service-control interfaces is the wire signature of remote service creation, a common remote-execution mechanism. Peer workstations normally have no reason to administer one another.
alert.detection_logic: NetworkFlow WHERE destination_port = 135 AND source_ip IN workstation_subnet AND destination_ip IN workstation_subnet FOLLOWED WITHIN 5s BY NetworkFlow FROM same source_ip TO same destination_ip ON ephemeral_port WHERE bytes_to_server > 4096
alert.data_source: Network sensor (flow records) at the WKS-4471 and WKS-4472 interfaces
